sentences.text: The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — is a mostly complete right dentary, or lower jaw bone, found in the upper Portezuelo Formation. This bone is squared-off rather than curved, with teeth crowded at the front of the jaw.
The genus was described by Calvo and González Riga in 2018. The only known species, B. mansillai, was named after Juan Eduardo Mansilla, a museum technician who discovered the fossil.
Baalsaurus belongs to the parent group Titanosauria and is classified within the class Saurischia.
Baalsaurus lived during the Late Cretaceous in Neuquén Province, Patagonia, Argentina. It lived between 93.9 and 85.7 million years ago, during the Turonian to Coniacian stages.
